note: All metadata and decode checks are automated; phash and filename pairs are similarity/source clues, not confirmed biological leaf identity. PlantDoc is entirely external test, so a single unsplit provenance-uncertain bucket may be used conservatively if retained. reviewed=true can describe reviewed group assignment policy, not manual disease validation or recovered leaf identities.

review_policy: Automated metadata/decode/hash checks; complete 551-image thumbnail screening plus targeted pair review. Disease labels remain original dataset annotations, not expert pathology diagnoses. Original filenames that clearly name incompatible species/diseases are excluded conservatively without relabeling. Presentations/documents/drawings/mixed collages excluded. All PD retained images stay external test.
